author_or_org: Junnan Kou, Ziyu Qing, Ruoxuan Wei, Fei Xue, Wen-You Huang, Hong Zhuang

claims.question: q6
claims.claim: CausalRCA is a four-layer framework for microservice root cause analysis that combines multi-modal data ingestion, a causal candidate graph unifying metrics, traces, logs, and topology into a temporal causal structure, and retrieval-augmented incident reasoning that grounds LLM inference in operational knowledge.
claims.quote: CausalRCA is proposed, a four-layer framework integrating multi-modal data ingestion, a causal candidate graph unifying metrics, traces, logs, and topology into a temporal causal structure, and retrieval-augmented incident reasoning grounding LLM inference in operational knowledge.

claims.question: q6
claims.claim: A comprehensive evaluation of microservice RCA found that no single method stands out in all situations; methods vary in effectiveness, efficiency, and sensitivity to specific parameters.
claims.quote: A comprehensive evaluation of nine causal discovery methods and twenty-one root cause analysis methods for microservice systems indicates that no method stands out in all situations; each method tends to either fall short in effectiveness, efficiency, or shows sensitivity to specific parameters.

claims.question: q5
claims.claim: MULAN applies unified multi-modal causal structure learning and contrastive learning to identify root causes in microservice systems.
claims.quote: This work proposes Mulan, a unified multi-modal causal structure learning method designed to identify root causes in microservice systems and proposes a contrastive learning-based approach to extract modality-invariant and modality-specific representations within a shared latent space.

claims.question: q6
claims.claim: TraceDiag is an end-to-end RCA framework for large-scale microservice systems that uses reinforcement learning to learn a pruning policy for the service dependency graph, eliminating redundant components and improving RCA efficiency.
claims.quote: TraceDiag is proposed, an end-to-end RCA framework that addresses the challenges for large-scale microservice systems and leverages reinforcement learning to learn a pruning policy for the service dependency graph to automatically eliminates redundant components, thereby significantly improving the RCA efficiency.

claims.question: q5
claims.claim: RUN uses neural Granger causal discovery with contrastive learning for root cause analysis and reports outperforming state-of-the-art RCA methods.
claims.quote: RUN is proposed, a novel approach for root cause analysis using neural Granger causal discovery with contrastive learning that noticeably outperforms the state-of-the-art root cause analysis methods.
